subject: lang
title: LANG.------(P)SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 185 (EVOL-23). LANG (language) is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner, with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From the subject: AFL (affinity alignment). From SOC-RT: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and VT-AF-ATT (vibrational affinity and/or attitude). From AFL: SOC-RT and AFL-DY-2 (affinity dynamics). From AFL-DY-2: ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of".
